text:
Noah: Silverline is greenlit for a 7-day hosted POC. Ask: per-integration hosted API keys, IP allowlist (198.51.100.77/32), audit logs to S3, daily rotation with 1h overlap, and automatic kill at end of trial. Who can own key creation and rotation?

Priya: I can create keys. Recommend ephemeral tokens, 24h TTL for dev keys and 48h for service integrations. We'll do per-integration naming so they can revoke single pieces. Example command: ```bash
redwoodctl keys create --type=ephemeral --scopes=generation,embeddings --allowed-ips=198.51.100.77/32 --ttl=48h --note="Silverline-<integration>"
```Returns JSON with key_id, token, created_at, expires_at. Deliver tokens to their Vault path or secure transfer.

Ilya: Compliance: all issuance/rotation/revoke events must include actor, key_id, scopes and delivery_method. For S3 export we need the bucket ARN and a cross-account role allowing PutObject. No CMK for hosted POC unless they request it.

Priya: Rotation plan: automation creates new key, writes token to their vault, waits 1h, then revokes old key via `redwoodctl keys revoke <old_key_id>`. I'll set up a scheduled revoke at day 7 00:00 UTC. If they request extension we update TTLs and rotation windows.

Noah: Please include a short handoff doc with curl examples and revoke steps. Quick usage snippet to include: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -d '{"input":"summarize notes"}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```

Ilya: Also, add audit annotations capturing previous_key_id -> new_key_id mapping on rotation. ops-bot: schedule a 24h expiry reminder.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled -> "Silverline POC: 24h expiry" at 2124566400.

Priya: Owners: Priya = creation + docs, Ilya = compliance sign-off, Noah = customer coordination. I'll request bucket ARN and a list of integrations from Silverline. Ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
